conclusion.claim: SplineOps cubic projection has lower exact-target NRMSE than every predeclared generic N-D resize alternative for the frozen controlled field class. A post-hoc SciPy polyphase FIR audit is more accurate, so field-wide scientific-resampling superiority is not demonstrated.
conclusion.scope_limit: Controlled continuous mirror-compatible 3-D cosine fields on the three tested endpoint/half-pixel geometries; not generic image or application superiority.
